state.task: Investigate only the CSS cascade that places the consent dialog below the viewport. React render behavior and component effects are outside this task.

artifacts.content:
.consent-dialog { position: fixed; inset: 1rem; overflow: auto; }
.dark > * { position: relative; top: 100vh; }
export function Consent() { return <section className="consent-dialog">Privacy choices</section>; }
